_readme: Module versions. Each version freezes ONE commit; CI builds that commit once and serves it at /versions/<module>/<version>/. Add a version only after asking Zeni: new version, or update the current one? See versions/README.md.

changes: Baseline: request listing grid and the full request detail page (V1), plus the V2 design option opened from INC-33.
Baseline: problem listing and detail page.
Baseline: change listing and detail page with lifecycle-stage status.
Baseline: release listing and detail page.
Baseline: task listing (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: approvals listing (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: knowledge listing (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: project listing (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: Hardware, Software, Non-IT and Consumable asset listings and detail pages, incl. the relationship topology and Software Meter.
Baseline: Software License, Contract and Purchase Order listings and detail pages.
Baseline: Base CI listing and the map-first CI detail page (Dependency Map / CI Details).
Baseline: Patches, Patch Deployments (incl. create form and topology), Endpoints, Automatic Patch Tests / Deployments, Package and Registry Deployments, and Admin › OS Upgrade.
Baseline: Vulnerabilities and Detected CVEs listings and detail pages.
Baseline: BOM Inventory, the endpoint BOM tab with versions and compare, and Admin › BOM Management (Licensing, Scheduler, Retention).
Baseline: Compliance Policy listing, form and detail page, Compliance Visualization, and Admin › Compliance Rules and Benchmark.
Baseline: dashboard boards, widget builder and Manage Dashboards (ported from ServiceOps_Dashboard_v2), with dark mode.
Baseline: reports listing (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: My Team page (from the upstream merge).
Baseline: portal listing cards, create flow, the full portal builder (widgets, banner, theme, branding, tour) and Settings.
The default portal is fixed; several portals can be published; Publish and Save as draft ask no confirmation.
Baseline: Form Builder (hover toolbar, Configure / Rules / Edit panels) and the Form Rule editor (V3 final, Rule check, help guide, illustrations page).
Baseline: workflow listing and the Linear builder, When step restyled (port in progress; Node view not built yet).
Baseline: survey listing with saved views, Import Emails panel, and Create User Survey with the single search-or-add Emails field.
